ingredients.raw: 1 (12 to 16 ounce) jar green enchilada sauce (or salsa verde)
ingredients.name: green enchilada sauce

ingredients.raw: 1.5 to 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.name: chicken thighs

ingredients.raw: 2 (15 ounce) cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cannellini beans

ingredients.raw: 2 cups kale, ribs removed and finely chopped
ingredients.name: kale

ingredients.raw: 4 ounces cream cheese, room temperature, cubed
ingredients.name: cream cheese

ingredients.raw: Freshly ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: black pepper

ingredients.raw: Optional garnishes: diced avocado, chopped cilantro, sour cream, extra cheese, crushed tortilla chips, lime wedges
ingredients.name: garnishes

instructions.text: Remove cream cheese from refrigerator to reach room temperature.
Add broth, enchilada sauce, chicken thighs, cannellini beans, green chiles, corn, kale, garlic powder, cumin, and oregano to a large pot.
Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce to medium and simmer 30 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a cutting board and shred using two forks (or chop if preferred).
Return shredded chicken to the pot; add cream cheese and Cheddar, stirring until melted and creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in lime juice.
Taste and season with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot in bowls; top with desired garnishes.
